high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article headline from Bloomberg.com, displayed on a smartphone. The time at the top of the screen reads 14:23, and there are various icons indicating battery status, signal strength, and other phone settings. The main focus of the image is a rendering of Chicago's O'Hare Airport undergoing a revamp. The airport terminal is depicted with a modern design featuring a large, curved roof covered in solar panels, suggesting an emphasis on sustainability. The terminal has a sleek, futuristic appearance with clean lines and a glass facade.
